info.title: Direct Service Transportation API
info.description: Internal REST API used only by the platform's own Blazor interface (API-01). All identifiers are opaque URL tokens. State-changing calls need the antiforgery header X-XSRF-TOKEN (GET /api/v1/auth/antiforgery). Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a 'code' and messages in the user's language.
